note: Parts as the builder constructs them, BEFORE the mandatory final mergeByMaterial (scripts/breads/focacciaOliveFlesh.ts). Slab = 1 mesh (crust-top + oil-pool baked into one basecolor texture). Olive-chunk = 11 separate revolved-shell meshes, each with a per-instance seg (12-16) and profile draw for silhouette variety -- NOT instanced, deliberately (see optimization-pass review: instancing would force identical geometry across chunks, reintroducing the uniform-dome defect the user rejected v2/v3 for). mergeByMaterial then fuses all 11 chunk meshes into 1 olive-flesh mesh and leaves the slab as its own mesh, for the consumer's 2-mesh/2-material cap (scripts/breads/types.ts sections 1-2). Triangle counts: slab is analytic (2*NX*NZ + 6*(NX+NZ) = 2*28*20 + 6*48 = 1408), chunk counts are per-instance (10*seg, seg in [12,16] => 120-160 each); breadlab-shot reported 2928 total for the seed used in review, consistent with 1408 slab + ~1520 across 11 chunks (avg ~138, i.e. avg seg ~13.8).
